shots.caption: The printer
shots.alt: The Inspector's device pane for the simulated Klipper 3D printer, paused, with its temperatures and extruder_target limited to 0 °C to 260 °C

shots.caption: The camera frame
shots.alt: The Inspector's camera pane with the latest demo frame, a line drawing of the print knocked over on the bed, image/jpeg, 640 × 480, 24 KB

shots.caption: The pending cancel
shots.alt: The Inspector's pending cancel. The agent print-watcher asks to run cancel on Klipper 3D printer, which can't be resumed, so it waits for a person, with the camera's frame beside Approve and run cancel and Reject

shots.caption: The message log
shots.alt: The Inspector's message log with hal/read results shown as image/jpeg 640 by 480 descriptions, hal/write answered by error -32010 LIMIT_EXCEEDED for a 300 °C nozzle, and the cancel answered pending

shots.caption: Stopped
shots.alt: The Inspector's stop banner, saying every command is refused with error -32014 STOPPED until a person lifts the stop with UNLOCK
